text:
raj_infra: quick heads-up — opened infra PR that changes how per-model runtime knobs are mounted. moving from individual ConfigMaps to a single namespaced ConfigMap with keys per-model. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/9876

jenna_pm: why the consolidation? is this for perf or easier ops?

raj_infra: both. reduces a bunch of k8s watches and should cut our config churn when we update many models at once. also simplifies TF logic for secrets binding.

alex_serving: concern — we currently rely on configmap checksum annotation to trigger rolling restarts for pods. does this change keep that behavior or will we need a new rollout hook?

raj_infra: good Q. plan is to keep checksum annotation but compute it from the subset key for the model, not full CM content. so rolling restart behavior per deployment stays intact.

maya_sre: FYI terraform plan shows a replace for the old per-model cm resources (they're renamed). that will delete and recreate if applied straight. we should avoid downtime for critical fleets.

raj_infra: agreed — my PR includes a migration step: create consolidated CM first, patch deployments to reference new key path and checksum annotation, then remove old CMs. need approval to add a one-off terraform apply script to run the intermediate step.

tom_devex: can you paste the snippet for the deployment patch? want to make sure our sidecar reads the new mount path.

raj_infra: sure — snippet below:

```yaml
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        configmap.k8s.redwood.com/knob-checksum: "{{checksum .ConfigMapData.per_model_key}}"
    spec:
      volumes:
        - name: knobs
          configMap:
            name: redwood-permodel-knobs
            items:
              - key: model-{{ .ModelName }}
                path: knobs.json
      containers:
        - name: runtime
          volumeMounts:
            - name: knobs
              mountPath: /etc/model/knobs
              readOnly: true
```

alex_serving: looks fine. main thing — ensure items.key exists for older models during migration or runtime must fallback to defaults. otherwise start errors.

raj_infra: plan includes a small init container that writes defaults if key missing. fallback logic also in runtime: if knobs.json absent, we log and continue with defaults.

maya_sre: still worried about TF replacing resources. propose: run `terraform apply -target=module.permodel_config.consolidated_cm` first, then update deployments with kubectl patch in a controlled window, then full tf apply to remove old CMs. I'll help coordinate.

jenna_pm: timeline — can this be done during the low-traffic window tomorrow 02:00-05:00 UTC? ops team wants at least 1hr heads-up.

raj_infra: yes, aiming for tomorrow 03:00 UTC. I'll put the migration script in the PR and tag infra-oncall.

tom_devex: small nit — adjust the TF outputs so deployers can read `consolidated_cm_name` and `checksum_for_<model>`; makes automation simpler.

raj_infra: good call, will add outputs and a tiny helper script: `./scripts/migrate-permodel-knobs --model=$MODEL`

deploy-bot: CI • infra/pr/9876 — all checks passed ✅

maya_sre: thanks. next steps: raj to add migration script + TF outputs; tom to validate sidecar mounts in dev cluster; i'll schedule the apply and coordinate with oncall; jenna to notify product teams. ping here once PR updated. :thumbsup:
